map.依据《劳动合同法》计算经济补偿金（N）、代通知金、违法解除赔偿金（2N）: Calculate economic compensation (N), notice pay, and wrongful-termination damages (2N) under the Labor Contract Law
map.填写「离职前12个月平均月工资（元）」。: Fill in "average monthly wage in last 12 months before leaving (yuan)".
map.填写「工作年限（年，可填小数如3.5）」。: Fill in "years of service (years, decimals allowed e.g. 3.5)".
map.填写「当地上年度职工月平均工资3倍（元，用于封顶）」。: Fill in "3x local prior-year average monthly wage (yuan, for cap)".
map.判断解除/终止劳动合同属于哪种情形，对应经济补偿 N、代通知金或赔偿金 2N。: Determine which case the rescission/termination of a labor contract falls into, corresponding to economic compensation N, notice pay, or damages 2N.
map.违法解除且劳动者不要求继续履行的，按经济补偿标准二倍支付赔偿金。: Wrongful termination where the worker does not demand continued performance is paid damages at double the economic compensation standard.
map.月工资超社平 3 倍的，基数封顶且年限最高 12 年。: Monthly wage above 3x the social average is capped, and years are capped at 12.
map.：工作 5 年、月薪 1.2 万、违法解除：赔偿金 = 12000 × 5 ×: : 5 years of service, monthly wage 12,000, wrongful termination: damages = 12000 x 5 x 2 = 120,000 yuan.
map.：用人单位提出协商解除，工作 8 年、月薪 1 万：经济补偿 = 10000 ×: : employer proposes mutual-agreement rescission, 8 years service, monthly wage 10,000: economic compensation = 10000 x 8 = 80,000 yuan (no 2N, no notice pay).

map.经济补偿免个税吗？: Is economic compensation exempt from personal income tax?
map.解除劳动关系取得的一次性补偿收入，在当地上年职工平均工资 3 倍数额以内的部分免: One-time compensation from terminating labor relations, the portion within 3x the local prior-year average wage is exempt from personal income tax; the excess applies the comprehensive income tax rate table separately.
map.主动辞职有补偿吗？: Is there compensation for voluntary resignation?
map.一般主动辞职无补偿；但因单位欠薪、未缴社保等违法情形被迫辞职的，可主张经济补偿。: Generally voluntary resignation has no compensation; but forced resignation due to illegal acts like unpaid wages or unpaid social insurance allows claiming economic compensation.
